query: SELECT observacoes LIKE '%[Import]%' as is_import, COUNT(*) as cnt, SUM(CAST(valor AS DECIMAL(12,2))) as total FROM lancamento_custo WHERE periodoCustoId = (SELECT id FROM periodo_custo WHERE mes = 5 AND ano = 2026 LIMIT 1) GROUP BY is_import;
